overall: The AG found the Peru Board of Selectmen violated the Open Meeting Law by convening its September 9, 2013 meeting before the posted time; the minutes, topic, quorum, and scheduling allegations were rejected.

allegations.summary: A discussion continued among one remaining board member and members of the public after the chair left, allegedly making the minutes inaccurate and raising a quorum issue.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the fact that one Board member continued a discussion with members of the public in Chair Raskin's absence, which was reflected in the meeting minutes, is not a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the August 19 and August 26, 2013 minutes were inaccurate, including listing a non-member as present and attributing statements to a complainant.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the minutes from the Board's August 19, 2013 and August 26, 2013 meetings were substantially accurate and detailed.

allegations.summary: The August 19 minutes allegedly listed a non-Board member as present, and the disputed attendance was challenged as inaccurate.
allegations.key_passage: we find this inaccuracy in the minutes was, at worst, a de minimis violation of the law.

allegations.summary: The August 26, 2013 meeting discussed an Open Meeting Law complaint that was not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: because Chair Haskins did not anticipate discussing Mr. Kaminski's August 12, 2013 Open Meeting Law complaint during the Board's August 26, 2013 meeting, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to include it as a topic on its meeting notice.

allegations.summary: The Board scheduled its meetings at the same time as other Town boards' meetings.
allegations.key_passage: it is not a violation of the Open Meeting Law to schedule a meeting at a time that may conflict with meetings of other public bodies.

allegations.summary: The September 9, 2013 meeting convened at 6:25 P.M. although the posted notice stated 7:00 P.M., allegedly violating the notice requirement.
allegations.key_passage: Even though it was an inadvertent error by the Clerk, the Board should not have convened its meeting earlier than the posted meeting time of 7 P.M.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
